s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of unilateral weakness in a child
key_facts: No recent infections or vaccinations beyond routine immunizations
No intracranial hemorrhage on head CT and brain MRI
Varix on the posterior inferior cerebellar artery (PICA) noted on brain MRI

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of unilateral weakness in a child
key_facts: No recent infections or vaccinations beyond routine immunizations
No intracranial hemorrhage on head CT and brain MRI
Varix on the posterior inferior cerebellar artery (PICA) noted on brain MRI

differentials: Mitochondrial myopathy, encephalopathy, lactic acidosis, and stroke-like episodes
per_call: Mitochondrial myopathy, encephalopathy, lactic acidosis, and stroke-like episodes

shortlist.label: Arteriovenous malformation
shortlist.why_kept: Sudden onset of unilateral weakness and varix on PICA

shortlist.label: Moyamoya disease
shortlist.why_kept: Acute onset of unilateral weakness in a child

shortlist.label: Primary CNS vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Unilateral weakness and normal laboratory studies

shortlist.label: Cerebral vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Acute onset of unilateral weakness and normal cerebrospinal fluid

raw.rationale: The presence of a varix on the posterior inferior cerebellar artery (PICA) noted on brain MRI, in combination with the sudden onset of left-sided weakness, suggests a vascular anomaly that could lead to the patient's symptoms.

rejected.label: Moyamoya disease
rejected.why: Typically presents with a history of recurrent strokes or transient ischemic attacks and often has a more gradual onset of symptoms

rejected.label: Acute disseminated encephalomyelitis
rejected.why: Usually follows a viral infection or vaccination and presents with more widespread neurological symptoms

rejected.label: Primary CNS vasculitis
rejected.why: Would likely have abnormal laboratory studies or cerebrospinal fluid findings

rejected.label: Cerebral vasculitis
rejected.why: Would also likely have abnormal laboratory studies or cerebrospinal fluid findings and often presents with more systemic symptoms
